summary: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing an Arrangement Agreement dated August 20, 2026, to acquire all outstanding common shares of Silver47 Exploration Corp. via a British Columbia plan of arrangement. Silver47 shareholders will receive 0.1724 Bunker Hill shares per Silver47 share, with fractional shares rounded down. Options will be exchanged into replacement options with adjusted exercise prices. The transaction requires approval by the Supreme Court of British Columbia and shareholders of both companies. Upon closing, Silver47 becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. No financial advisors or premium details were disclosed. Watch for court and shareholder approvals, exchange ratio arbitrage, and any competing bids.
